_doc: Daeun (大運) rules. Direction: yang year stem + male, or yin year stem + female → FORWARD; otherwise BACKWARD. Start age = (days from birth to the next (forward) / previous (backward) 節 solar term) / daysPerYear. The traditional ratio is 3 days = 1 year (1 day = 4 months, 1 two-hour 時 = 10 days).
_roundingModes: EXACT keeps fractional ages (e.g. 7.42); ROUND uses the conventional integer 대운수 (rounded, minimum 1).
